title: Mona Lisa
official_description: A portrait of a seated woman with a subtle smile, painted by Leonardo da Vinci in the early sixteenth century.
historical_context: Created during the Italian Renaissance, a period of renewed interest in realistic human portraits.
visual_description: A woman sits calmly with folded hands and a faint smile, set against a hazy distant landscape of winding paths and mountains.

chunks.text: The Mona Lisa is an early sixteenth century portrait by Leonardo da Vinci of a seated woman with a famously subtle smile.
She sits with her hands gently folded and a faint smile, while a soft, hazy landscape of paths and mountains stretches behind her.
The painting reflects Renaissance interest in naturalism and the soft blending of tones, a technique that softens edges between light and shadow.
La Joconde est un portrait du debut du seizieme siecle par Leonard de Vinci, representant une femme assise au sourire subtil et celebre.
Elle est assise, les mains doucement croisees et un leger sourire, devant un paysage brumeux de chemins et de montagnes.
